name: Pistol Arena [UPD]
desc:
Fast-paced free-for-all arena where everyone has a one-hit pistol. Grab your gun and hunt down your opponents!

🎯 Eliminate other players
🔫 Unlock new pistols
🔥 No teams, just pure skill

This game is in beta, report bugs in the group forums!

Controls:

[PC] 💻
Mouse 1 - Shoot
Mouse 2 - Aim
Left Shift - Sprint
Ctrl / C / F - Slide

[Controller] 🎮
R2 - Shoot
L2 - Aim
B / Circle / Press Left Stick - Slide

[Mobile] 📱
Tap the buttons on screen for all actions.
(Hold Shoot to Aim)
